reuse.why: Edits only getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts, the existing single helper every server and client site uses, still relying on getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance.

duplication.why: No duplicated logic; the two branches become simpler expressions.

placement.why: The rule stays in the shared schedule-amount helper.

scope.why: One helper and its tests; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: Minimal change to the single definition of the rule, with tests covering income, expense and zero-spanning ranges.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All planned-amount sites (api.ts, forecast-schedules, schedules/app, schedule-template, preview, SchedulesTable) call getScheduledAmount.
